translation.name: GOD ETER AGERKE NAMDERASEM TUMA YENBO

book.name: MATYU
book.title: MATYU Matyu ere bas rasem Tuma Yenbo.

content: Now yaku kerebetem tame etemri sekur sakur tuma.
Jisas ere etep wom. Keryen God eri kom panen site wule ere gwopkap. Tame ere now eisau temenem. Eipipiwai ere yin now yaku kerete tame sopte yim.
Yin lam, ere emne etep wom. Kem yabel wuri yaku kerete, an kel ep yekwo let ep yekwo let kemne wurare wurare newote. Etep womke, eme kir tem, ere emne now yaku won yim.
Keru yabelke ere komke yin lam, kau tame eme bepou me temenem, eme yakuken berai.
Lan, ere emne etep wom. Kem ari now yaku kerete, an kemne tokwo yenbo newote. Etep womke, eme eri wom yaku yim.
Yabel me pebetem, ere komke sene yim. Yuri ere sene yin yaku kere tame kau sene petem.
Perpe ere sene yin lam, kau tame eme bepou me tetemenem. Ere emne etep wom. Kem bepou me teteten.
Eme awosein etep wom. Nemne eike tame yaku wuri beke newo. Ere etep wom. Kem ari now yaku kerete.

Perpe tebetemke, now maime ere yaku lakere tame erne ere etep wom. Ne yaku kere tame emne wo peten tokwo newote. Tipti yawo tame emne ne tokwo kiyi newote. Kiyi yawo tame emne ne tokwo yurik newote. Etep wom.
Tiptiwuk yam tame eme yam, kel epe yekwo let epe yekwo let eme wurare wurare petem.
Yaku kiyi taresin kerem tame eme yan etep lan, eme etep abom. Nema kap kel nogwapeke pette. Etep abom, kel ep yekwo let ep yekwo let eme kir petem.
Petemke, eme now maime erne etep wom.

Ete tame eme yurik yawo, eme yaku nogwape beke kere. Eme yaku kerake kereye. Nerem, nema keruke yawo, yabel eisau nemri wuske pasrasbe, nema yaku eisau kenake kereye. Ne nemne etemne newoye tokwokap newoye. E yaper.

Now maime ere etemri tame wuri erne awosein etep wom. Metye. An nene yaper beke nen. An nene kiyi woye. Ne ane yaku kerete, kel ep yekwo let ep yekwo let an nene newote woye. Ari woyekap, an etepke toboye.
Nene newoye tokwo ne peten sen yi. Nene newoye tokwokap an aboye, an yuri yawo tame emne etepke kir newote.
E areri wos. Kel nogwape e areri kel. An newote wote, kem mane wote. An yenboke nenye, eke an emne bepou me newoye, beke ne pap yaper teye. Etep wom.

Jisas ere sene etep wom. Tatame eme God eri komke yite, eme etepkap pette. Ane kiyi kenawaike abobe tatame, ane yuri kenawaike abobe tatame eme tokwo wurisubu pette. Eme kena kena beke kip pet. Etep wom.
Jisas ere tewo mur sene etep wom. An sate, an sene wayen yite.
Jisas ere Jerusalem komke yibetem, ere tatame nogwape emne mesginin ere ep yekwo let ep yekwo let tewo bor pes kei tame (12-pela) emne etep wom.

Kem ek met. Gwopte nema Jerusalemke yaute. An tatame etemne lan yam tame, eme ane keresukun eme ane panen yite. God eri akek yaku kerebe tame emri apeilake etem, Moses eri wule wusoube tame etem eme ane etemke panen yite. Eme ane pen sate nenbe.
Sene eme Juda berai tame etem, eme ane peten ane tuma yaper won paku pete, ane mek kwuran kwanen an sate. Neir mur tetek, an sene wayen yite. Jisas ere emne etep wom.
Jemsken Jonken epe apeilake tete wom.
Sebeti eri yen pes epri nawo te yen epne Jisas eterke panen yan, te gulke pan Jisas erne wote abom.
Jisas ere tene wometem. Ne be woske aboye? Te awosein etep wom. Yuri ne apeilake tete, ne wolbaye eisauke site, an aboye, areri yen pes epe nerenken kom panen site.

Etep womke, Jisas ere tene awosein etep wom. Neri wometye tuma ne noub beke abo Etep wom, ere epne wometem. Eme ane yaper nente, an mus mette, kap kep kir kuyese mus mette, o kap ane mesginte. Mus mette, e ok yaper abekap. Epe awosein etep wom. Berai. Nesa nene beke kip mesgin.

Ere etep wom. Ye. Eme ane yaper nentekap, eme kepne kir yaper nente. Aren, an beke kip wo, eike ari ya gwaimeken ya mameken site. E ari yaku berai. Ari Apei eterwou ere wote, eike etek site. Ere etep wom.
Jisas eri akeite anepoi tame ep yekwo let ep yekwo let eme ete tuma metemke, eme ete yen pes epne tuma wom.
Tuma won, Jisas ere emne won yan emne etep wom. Nowselri apeilake eme emri kulke tetan tatame emne yaku eisau newobe. Eme yaku beke kere, apeilake eme emne paku pete.
Emri tebekap, kem mane tobote. Kem apeilake tete aboye, kem yaku kere tamekap tete.
Kem apeilake tete abote, kem tatame nogwape emne yaku kerete.

An Tatame Etemne Late Yeirim Tame, an etepwou tebe. An yam, an beke wo, tatame eme ane yaku kerete. Berai. An yam, an etemne yaku kerete yam. An tatame emne kobo late yam. Eme ane pen sate, an emne tuken emri wule yaper peten sepitte. Jisas ere etep wom.
Jisas ere le si tame pes eyarem.
Eme Jeriko kom mesginin yibetem, tatame nogwape eme Jisas erne semowun yim.
Yibetemke, le si tame pes epe kelu ganke simenem, epe metem, Jisas ere ete keluke yabetem. Etep metem, epe noubke ten etepke wom. Jisas, ne Devit eteri nan, ne nesetne kobo late.
Tatame eme epne wotaken etep wom. Kep elen te. Etep womke, epe sene noubke etep wom. Jisas, ne Devit eteri nan, ne nesetne kobo late. Etep wom.
Jisas ere epri tuma meten, ere epne wometem. Kep aboye, an kepne be woske nente?
Epe awosein etep wom. Aneyen, nesa abobe, nesetri le ne eyarte.
Jisas ere epne kobo lam, eke ere epri le letke kerem. Keren, epe le sene kuyese lam, epe erne semowun eme etep yim.
